name: Mistaken
storyline:
A world consumed by mist and affliction.

Humanity is gone, and hope for its return grows fainter by the day.

Fight, build, and push deeper into the ruins of a world that refuses to die quietly.

Mistaken is a dark fantasy survival RPG centered around satisfying progression, powerful build creation, and expanding a refuge in a world that has already fallen.

Fight your way through dangerous realms, gather rare resources, defeat horrific creatures, and descend deeper into the mist in search of stronger gear, new crafting options, and devastating character builds.

Despite its bleak world, Mistaken blends moody dark fantasy with charm, rewarding exploration, and addictive progression systems designed to constantly give the player new goals to chase.

Explore, Fight, Progress
The gameplay loop in Mistaken is simple, satisfying, and difficult to put down:

Explore → Gather → Fight → Upgrade → Expand → Descend Further

Each journey into the mist offers stronger enemies, rarer materials, hidden structures, dangerous bosses, and new opportunities to push your build even further.

The deeper you go, the stranger and deadlier the world becomes.

Create Powerful Builds
Progression in Mistaken is all about experimentation and growth.

Weapons, armor, and equipment roll with randomized attributes and affixes, allowing even ordinary gear to become something powerful in the right build. Shape your character around different combat styles, strategies, and synergies as you steadily become stronger with each expedition.

Choose an Origin that defines the strengths and weaknesses of your character.

Lean fully into devastating magic, specialize in ranged combat, become a brutal frontline fighter, or choose the path of a nomad, free to experiment and adapt without a predefined direction.

Each Origin opens the door to different builds, strategies, and progression paths, with many more planned throughout Early Access.

Collect Cartifacts
Cartifacts are mysterious magical cards that can be equipped to fundamentally change how your build functions.

Each Cartifact grants unique combat effects that can synergize with one another in powerful ways, opening the door for countless strategies and combinations.

Why not equip one Cartifact that causes melee attacks to poison enemies, then combine it with another that increases critical strike chance against poisoned targets?

The deeper you progress, the more possibilities become available.

Build and Expand Your Settlement
Your base is more than just decoration. It is a core part of progression.

Gather resources to build shelters, crafting stations, farms, storage, defenses, and homes for wandering survivors. As your settlement grows, new crafting options, beneficial NPCs, sustainable food production, and progression opportunities become available.

Start with a small refuge and slowly transform it into a thriving stronghold standing against the mist.
summary: The world is lost to eldritch mist. No heroes, no grand purpose—only survival. Build, fight, and carve your path through treacherous lands where the remnants of humanity and horrors beyond reason now roam. Survive… or be Mistaken.
